name: Embossed picture
description: A picture or video pressed into a sheet of paper: its light parts raised and its dark parts sunk (or the other way), lit from one side, keeping as much of its colour as you like.

name: Paper-cut waves
description: Sheets of white paper cut into waves and stacked, each casting a soft shadow on the one beneath, the stack undulating gently.

name: Paper relief text
description: A word shaped out of a white sheet, its letters cut into the paper or raised from it (or cut in at one end and rising at the other), drawn only by light and the soft shadows of their walls.

controls.l: Depth at the start (− cut in)
Depth at the end (− cut in)

name: Ink-splashed hexagons
description: Raised hexagon tiles on a cracked plaster wall, those deep in the cluster black and marbled with cracks, the rest white, with ink spattered and smudged across the wall around them.

name: Hexagon relief
description: White hexagon tiles raised from a white wall at different heights, gathering toward one side with a few strays, lit from the side so only their soft shadows draw them, rising and settling slowly.

name: Emergency alert
description: A phone's emergency alert dropping in from the top of the screen: a dark card with a red warning icon ringing out, the alert's level, a bold title and its message, buzzing twice as it lands, holding, then sliding away.

controls.d: Move to higher ground now. Avoid walking or driving through flood water. Check local news for updates.

texts.name: body
texts.label: Message
texts.default: Move to higher ground now. Avoid walking or driving through flood water. Check local news for updates.

name: Caution tape
description: Yellow and black caution tape snapping across the frame from either side, crossed in an X or as one band, its warning repeated along it, fluttering while it holds, then torn down and dropping away.

name: Red alert
description: A picture as the main lights cut to emergency power: the scene drops into shadow and turns red, lit by a beacon spinning overhead whose beam sweeps across it, with a slow red pulse and the corners falling into dark. It sweeps at most one and a half times a second.

name: Siren lights
description: The red and blue wash of an emergency vehicle's light bar spilling over the frame from above: the two lamps taking turns, or spinning so their beams sweep across, glowing through a faint haze. It lights up at most one and a half times a second.

name: Film projector
description: A vintage film projector running: its two reels turning, the film feeding through it from one to the other, and a flickering cone of light streaming from its lens with dust drifting through the beam, on a seamless loop.

name: Dramatic letterbox
description: A picture's big moment: cinema bars slam in from the top and bottom, bouncing and shaking the frame as they land, while the picture pushes slowly in and the grade turns moody, contrasty and teal and orange; then it all eases back. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Film damage
description: A picture as a battered old print: scratches running down it that come and go, dust and the odd hair flashing past for a frame, emulsion blotches, flicker and a faded colour, the frame jumping at bad splices and a cue mark blinking in the corner.

name: Film strip
description: A picture running through a strip of film: frame after frame of it sliding past between rows of sprocket holes, with frame lines, printed edge marks along the margin and a little dust and flicker, lit from behind as on a lightbox; upright or across, tilted if you like, or as an orange-based negative.

name: CRT terminal
description: An old phosphor terminal typing out its lines one after another behind a block cursor, glowing green through scanlines with a vignette and a faint bar rolling down the glass, then clearing to type again.

controls.d: > BOOT SEQUENCE INITIATED; > CHECKING MEMORY ... 640K OK; > LOADING SYSTEM FILES; > ESTABLISHING LINK; > READY.

name: CRT television
description: A picture on an old television set in a dark room: a wooden cabinet with a rounded, bulging screen, its dial knobs and speaker grille, rabbit-ear antennas on top, scanlines and a little snow on the glass, its glare, and the screen's light spilling onto the wall and floor.

name: Vertical roll
description: A picture on a tube set that has lost its vertical hold: the picture rolling up the screen with the black blanking bar between frames, the lines tearing sideways near it, then (if you like) slowing and catching again as if someone fixed the knob.

name: CRT power
description: A picture on an old tube television switching on and off: a bright line stretching across the dark screen and opening out into the picture, overbright for a moment, then later squashing back down to a glowing line, shrinking to a dot and fading away. Loops; or turn Animate off and set Power.

name: Pixel bloom reveal
description: A logo-sting loop: squares pop out from the centre along a sunflower spiral, the bloom holds and shimmers, then it spins away into pixel dust from the edge in. On a clear background; works as a loader.

name: Pixel bloom transition
description: Squares on a sunflower spiral grow out from the centre, each carrying the next picture, until they cover the frame; a glow rides the growing edge. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Pixel bloom
description: Rounded squares on a sunflower spiral, big at the bright centre and shrinking to pixel dust toward the edge, turning slowly while a shimmer ripples outward. On a clear background, for logos, headers and loaders.
